# Mehmet IPA

Mehmet IPA is a Turkish-language iOS app and IPA signing platform. Visitors can explore the public game catalogue and guides. Registered members can access account features, and VIP membership provides access to Mehmet IPA's IPA-signing workflow and certificate features.

## Main website

- Home: https://mehmetipa-signer.pages.dev/
- Privacy policy: https://mehmetipa-signer.pages.dev/privacy/
- Legal information: https://mehmetipa-signer.pages.dev/legal/

## Platform features

- Public iOS game catalogue and related guides
- Member registration and sign-in
- VIP membership and certificate access
- Browser-based iOS IPA signing workflow
- Signed IPA download
- Account and device management
- Administrative membership and device management

## Signing notes

Signing and installation compatibility depend on the iOS version, device, provisioning profile, certificate status, and browser capabilities. Apple may revoke certificates; Mehmet IPA does not represent that every certificate or signed app will remain valid indefinitely.

## Support and source
